Valiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build internal applications, automations, and AI tools that improve staff efficiency. The role works with teams across the company to identify workflow problems, develop and measure solutions, and support AI development and enablement.
Cyber Security
Information Technology
Security
Comp. & Benefits
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Your core work is building software, automation, and AI tools that give Valiant staff time back. When IT gets busy, you also help the team with escalations
Develop projects from the VITALs backlog, from project charter and definition of done through sprints, launch, and measurement
Build and maintain apps on our internal Micro-App Platform for finance, contracts, HR, and other internal teams
Move workflows out of low-code apps and into custom apps when they outgrow them
Work with the IT Systems Administrator to further automate IT tasks and management, from account provisioning and offboarding to Google Workspace administration and reporting
Build and maintain integrations between our business systems
Run user acceptance testing with each app's users, and confirm every app works on real tasks before launch
Ship through GitHub with code review, CI, tests, and a runbook for each release
Help set Valiant's AI development strategy: where AI fits, how we evaluate it, and how we deploy it securely
Build AI features, agents, and automations with LLM APIs and MCP servers, then measure the results against the manual baseline
Test new AI models and tools as they release, and recommend what Valiant adopts. Advise Valiant on modern AI tools and research, such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, and keep the company current as the field changes. Your recommendations inform adoption and risk decisions by the CTO and Engineering lead
Train staff to use AI tools well through sessions, written guides, and one-on-one help
Meet with staff and department leads to learn how their work gets done. Find the slow, manual, or error-prone steps in their workflows, and turn them into scoped plans with a measured baseline
Keep exploring new ways technology can improve how Valiant works, and bring forward the ideas worth testing
Contribute to the project that defines Valiant's future app architecture, including how apps share data, sign users in, and connect to business systems

Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, in writing and in conversation
Ability to learn how a team works, find where it slows down, and plan the fix
Self-direction in a fully remote team
Preferred
Google Cloud or another major cloud, plus Docker
Next.js or React
Workflow automation tools, such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script
LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, orAI coding tools such as Claude Code
Google Workspace administration or GAM
IT support experience
Experience training users or running user acceptance testing
Benefits
Eligible full-time employees receive a choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions.
Eligible full-time employees receive dental and vision coverage for themselves and their family.
Eligible full-time employees receive company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance.
Eligible full-time employees may choose optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage.
Eligible full-time employees receive a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
Eligible full-time employees receive paid time off that grows with years of service, plus paid federal holidays.
Eligible full-time employees receive paid certifications, professional development, and access to the Valiant University training portal.
Eligible full-time employees receive flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program.
Eligible full-time employees may receive referral bonuses when they help bring great people to Valiant.
100% remote work.
